intervals.label: cavern excavation and outfitting
intervals.quote: Engineering, construction and excavation teams have been working 4,850 feet below the surface since 2021

intervals.label: cryostat and detector installation
intervals.note: Fermilab stated in February 2024 that installation of the steel cryostat structure was planned to begin later that year; no confirmation of the actual start was fetched.
intervals.quote: Later this year, the project team plans to begin the installation of the insulated steel structure that will hold the first neutrino detector.

intervals.label: operational
intervals.note: Project goal as stated by Fermilab in February 2024.
intervals.quote: The goal is to have the first detector operational before the end of 2028.

placements.note: Installed in the north detector cavern on the 4850 Level at SURF; no installation start date is given in the fetched sources.
placements.quote: The DUNE FD will consist of four LArTPC detector modules , each with a LAr mass in the sensitive region of the cryostat (fiducial mass) of at least 10 kt , installed approximately 1.5 km underground.

cryostat_count.display: 1 cryostat, 15.1 m (w) x 14.0 m (h) x 62.0 m (l) internal
cryostat_count.note: Count of 1: this record describes a single far-detector module (FD1); the source says each LArTPC module fits inside one cryostat of the quoted internal dimensions.
cryostat_count.quote: Each LArTPC fits inside a cryostat of internal dimensions 15.1 m (w) × 14.0 m (h) × 62.0 m (l)

drift_length.quote: The maximum drift length is 3.5 m .

fiducial_mass.quote: each with a LAr mass in the sensitive region of the cryostat (fiducial mass) of at least 10 kt

phase.quote: the single- and dual-phase DUNE liquid argon TPC far detector modules

readout.quote: An SP module is instrumented with three module-length (58.2 m) anode planes constructed from 6 m high by 2.3 m wide anode plane assemblies (APAs), stacked two APAs high and 25 wide, for 50 APAs per plane, and 150 total. ... with three layers of active wires
readout.value: three module-length anode planes built from 150 anode plane assemblies (APAs), each 6 m high by 2.3 m wide, with three layers of active wires

target_medium.quote: modular liquid argon time-projection chamber (LArTPC) ... of liquid argon (LAr), a cryogenic liquid that must be kept at 88 K (−185°C)

total_mass.display: 17.5 kt of liquid argon per cryostat
total_mass.quote: The DUNE FD cryostats will hold 17.5 kt of LAr each, for a total of nearly 70 kt

description.quote: for 50 APA s per plane, and 150 total
description.value: 150 wire-readout anode plane assemblies forming three 58.2 m long anode planes

description.quote: Each of the four drift volumes of LAr is subjected to a strong E field of 500 V/cm, corresponding to a cathode high voltage (HV) of 180 kV.
description.value: Four drift volumes at a 500 V/cm field, with a cathode high voltage of 180 kV

description.quote: A photon detection system supplements the TPC, directly enhancing physics capabilities for all three DUNE physics drivers
description.value: Photon detectors supplementing the TPC and extending the physics reach

summary.plain: The first of four giant tanks of liquid argon nearly a mile underground in South Dakota. Charged particles from neutrino collisions leave trails of electrons that drift sideways onto walls of wires, producing a photograph-like picture of each event.
summary.technical: Single-phase horizontal-drift LArTPC: 17.5 kt of liquid argon in a 15.1 x 14.0 x 62.0 m membrane cryostat, at least 10 kt fiducial, four drift volumes at 500 V/cm with a 3.5 m maximum drift and 150 APAs of wire readout, plus a photon detection system.

technology.quote: In the single-phase liquid argon time-projection chamber (LArTPC) technology, ionization charges drift horizontally in the liquid argon under the influence of an electric field towards a vertical anode, where they are read out with fine granularity.
technology.value: single-phase horizontal-drift liquid argon time projection chamber with anode plane assembly wire readout
